description: This file contains shell script functions related to code review workflows for GitHub pull requests. It includes functions for setting review modes, claiming reviews, checking out PR branches, validating review artifacts, initializing review environment, and running tests related to pull requests.

methods.name: set_review_mode
methods.description: Sets the review mode environment variable and writes it to a file, used to determine review context (main or PR).

methods.name: review_claim
methods.description: Claims a reviewer for a pull request by retrieving the GitHub username and assigning it as an assignee to the PR.

methods.name: review_checkout_main
methods.description: Checks out the main branch of the repository in a detached HEAD state for review baseline.

methods.name: review_checkout_pr
methods.description: Checks out the branch for a specific PR in a detached HEAD state for review.

methods.name: review_guard
methods.description: Verifies that the review environment is correctly set up and that the current HEAD matches the expected state based on mode.

methods.name: review_artifacts_init
methods.description: Initializes review artifacts such as markdown and JSON templates to prepare for code review.

methods.name: review_validate_artifacts
methods.description: Validates that review artifacts conform to expected structure and content rules.

methods.name: review_tests
methods.description: Runs test targets during review to ensure test coverage and correctness.

methods.name: review_init
methods.description: Initializes a review environment for a PR, setting up worktrees and metadata files.
